# Block `recall`

**Use:** Flashcards for active recall: a prompt and its answer.

**Avoid:** Long answers (keep each under 40 words).

## Example

```json
{
  "kind": "recall",
  "cards": [
    {
      "prompt": "What does an index trade for faster reads?",
      "answer": "Extra storage and slower writes."
    },
    {
      "prompt": "Which index supports range scans?",
      "answer": "A B+ tree."
    }
  ],
  "source": [
    {
      "file": "slides.pdf",
      "page": 4
    }
  ]
}
```

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | `"recall"` | yes |
| `source` | array of object (1–5) | no |
| `source[].file` | string | yes |
| `source[].page` | integer (≤ 9007199254740991) | yes |
| `cards` | array of object | yes |
| `cards[].prompt` | string | yes |
| `cards[].answer` | string | yes |

Every block may carry `source`: 1–5 `{ "file", "page" }` references to the material it came from.
